result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For a small company, I'd shortlist **Breathe HR, CharlieHR, BambooHR, Employment Hero and HiBob** if you're UK-based.

My recommendation would be **Breathe HR or CharlieHR for a smaller business**, depending on how much functionality you need. If you're planning significant growth, I'd look at Employment Hero or HiBob.

## Best HR software for small companies

![HR Software for UK SMEs – Trusted by 17,000+ organisations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ROJAyOfUjHKEuFBNF1pHBPQHM0PLuIvCK0q8KQmZrpoEEyCHgmWjxWwAG_Ie8huEC0fFM24TmHCcpJtbR20JLvAHxGrWA4a6X3g_walj1XXFjcLPUM-k569UTN3Z62cwoEkeqnSg04nvlm5wphVNQ53Z9B30NqsDUYyfVczvoF43_i0QLqIID3NrWQR4SDCe?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Breathe HR**

(Best for simplicity)

- Employee records and documents
- Holiday and absence management
- Performance reviews
- Training records

Ideal for small UK businesses wanting straightforward HR administration.

[Breathe HR website](https://www.breathehr.com/)

---

![Charlie Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/noUj6MXVV_rGiJLKtx7Sco_uFMazap-Xj1f5ZnbuWxRGBtoatMU6LXITBFxA8JUNPcWFD9T5pr_JiMeu656E7ai9bkUmdzZ5rOMZPBS9cgUZr_b99qJ7RflQxghLNMkwNZfoMUQ-02gNA9PIKaI2sy72PQwjqiP-vw0XxBZrHM6gFjfEXb1dklqCyzGWic1V?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. CharlieHR**

(Best all-round option for small teams)

- Holiday requests and approvals
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Employee records
- HR workflows and reminders

Particularly attractive for businesses wanting easy-to-use HR without unnecessary complexity.

[CharlieHR website](https://www.charliehr.com/)

---

![Free High-Quality Bamboohr Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NdLSBGjy-t4LAE90fgF-ddR4i37sUJnkP2I2etLyMCzK30ZNnDLeOFNkJ4ONgornqI4dpQO60O7vJzcBWlKGYP0PmgOwkcxyOEu4BL3JtyYZ8ZsdTCrW5IgVGOXAbKINwLVIP8GRxZkWvj639AwhCvO-Z0MW5ibDEnj4uSEouHdZBnZYXe0Ke7Brv94puUyT?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. BambooHR**

(Best for comprehensive HR)

- Recruitment and onboarding
- Performance management
- Employee information
- Reporting and analytics

Good if you want a more sophisticated HR system that can grow with the company.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Employment Hero revenue, funding & news | Sacra](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fzjrXPaeDGwbU0ktEn3_TQOhXXDHf36IZVXODrp9T7HoPtffJn3log8dcNXgqmxNTVoSA7Z8uruA7pqFNxyUEhGcStTX98s15F3_UqZVdwX3Hil0ScIjHbsYgq5CRV83FbCLkZXcqjEJTHBYwixjaLt2P4LznFNYwuYqYTuorQs3fGdTLjy3xRq6ouhsJUWG?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Employment Hero**

- HR administration and employee records
- Payroll options
- Recruitment and onboarding
- Employment documentation and workflows

Worth considering if you want HR and payroll capabilities under one roof.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

---

![Remote Jobs in Germany | Remote Job Board](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/_xz8zdKNnibaS00tTrW6vidgZMnBB6HQDwbbW5Q2KLS5mre_qhg31AhZIO_IwrFxk3GBjpp5G0bv2jIKvxV5uaX58G2tAkEYC5kK9xotVJVxfNubGlJ0f9KHvSKy29UOY2w_ZvSBiB0dobXqDINBMEsnSVM75ouH6of9Pyek9MYxHPk4GVsGxiewFerf0ZeN?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. HiBob**

- Employee engagement
- Performance management
- Organisational planning
- HR analytics and automation

Better suited to a growing company with more sophisticated HR requirements.

[HiBob website](https://www.hibob.com/)

These choices reflect current UK-focused comparisons, including CharlieHR's small-team offering and Breathe HR's focus on SME administration. ## My recommendation

| Your business situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–10 employees | CharlieHR |
| 10–30 employees | Breathe HR |
| 30–100 employees | BambooHR |
| HR and payroll together | Employment Hero |
| Rapidly growing business | HiBob |
